feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 October 2026 10:36pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over northern Germany, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east of the area tomorrow morning and early afternoon, gradually veering south or southwest tomorrow afternoon. Then becoming north 4 or 5 in the west of the area early tomorrow night.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Risk of fog patches in the east of the area at first tomorrow morning and again later. Light rain progressing eastwards early tomorrow night.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, but north 4 or 5 in the west of the area, becoming 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Sunday. Then veering northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate the west Sunday morning and afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain for a time overnight. Risk of fog patches in the east of the area until later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally very poor in any fog patches.
